required_qualifications: Pass applies only to the exact decomposition and sharp long-factor Type I partial saving. No complete Mobius mixed-moment saving, variance extension, or RH result is established.
Keep k=2 fixed for the audited split, U=sqrt(2D) exactly, and D>2. The sufficient whole-block support condition is U^k>=2D; k may not grow with T without new uniform accounting.

Interpret TI in its stated context D comparable to T^(5/6), or in the explicitly justified small fixed neighborhood 1/2<d<1. Fixed support widths and comparability constants are part of the constant ledger.

Use real imaginary-part shifts |u|<=T^(1/2+eta), with zeta at its original argument and |2t+u| comparable to T. There is no real-part-shift, near-zero-height, or arbitrary time-dependent-coefficient extension.
The dual coefficient-1 factor is real. Modulus conjugation does not preserve arbitrary complex dual coefficients unchanged. The other polynomial may have any fixed complex tau_2-bounded coefficients.
Retain endpoint terms, the inside-supported taper, and its T^epsilon(1+T/D^2) sharp error. Arbitrary oscillatory product masks are not covered by bounded endpoint-mask uniformity.

The allowed C0 threshold has fixed eta>0. At eta=0, or after spending the full 2eta margin, this argument gives no strict saving. All dyadic, Mellin, maximal, moment, and divisor losses share one budget.
No AFE application with a dual cutoff below 1, no low-height shell, and no unrestricted C0~T or larger regime is certified by this proof.
J-rem remains an unproved bound for the whole exact sharp residual. A termwise route needs controlled common shifts and loss slack; u=0 alone is insufficient.

A variance extension requires uniform full-residual saving in an open height-length neighborhood plus all tail blocks, cumulative heights, masks, and the remaining spectral/endpoint/centering reductions.

The classical AFE, polynomial mean-value theorem, and zeta fourth moment are accepted theorem inputs read in the supplied archived statements. Fresh DLMF retrieval was blocked by 403; no successful fresh source inspection is claimed.
This is an informal independent mathematical audit. Exact finite checks and phase diagnostics verify bounded algebra/accounting, not an asymptotic missing joint estimate or the deep theorem inputs.

reviewed_claims.finding: The finite binomial identity is exact; the remainder has index at least (floor(U)+1)^k>U^k.
The actual split keeps k=2 fixed and U^2=2D, covers the full half-open block, and deletes 2A_U only because D>2.
All c>=C* tuples are assigned once, with singleton and threshold intervals retained; beta is tau_2-bounded and RC0 is comparable to D.
The exact Mellin measure du/(2pi), phase D^(iu), common +u shift, logarithmic L1 cost, and fixed-order tail are correct.
The actual sharp boundary error is T^epsilon(1+T/D^2) in squared mixed norm and is O(T^epsilon) near d=5/6; not just a smooth-model result.
Both x cutoffs meet x,y>=1; their dual interval is v/(2pi C1)<ell<=v/(2pi C0), with O(C0^-1+T^-1/2) error.
The squared chi amplitude is (2pi/|v|)coth(pi|v|/2); both phase signs, modulus-only conjugation, and dt=dv/2 are accounted for.
The exact intermediate norm is sum_m|d_J(m)|^2 <= max tau_4(m) * W_B^2 * |J|^2, with W_B=sum |beta_r|^2/r^2.
A binary-interval maximal fourth moment costs at most log^4(2L), using summed norms at each disjoint level; no factor L is lost.
Reconstructed the actual three terms 1+T/D+T^(3/2)/C0^2 from the uncompressed norm and amplitude formula.
Every marked sharp Type I box sums to a saving for C0>=T^(7/12+eta); fixed log^20 and an explicit divisor-loss allocation fit strictly inside eta.
Integer endpoint crossings, very short intervals, R~1, and RL~sqrt(T) are covered; low heights, C~T with y<1, and d<=1/2 are not silently extrapolated.
The two original sharp residuals partition the exact finite identity; weighted L2 triangles give the stated fixed-saving equivalence, but J-rem is unproved.
The Type I formula is uniform in a small neighborhood, but the full residual and all-height/all-block variance interface still require new estimates.

checks.scope_limit: Finite checks are not proofs of analytic moment estimates. Full normalization, sharp-transfer, and uniformity deductions are given in report.md.

summary: The exact fixed-order Mobius decomposition and the claimed T^epsilon(1+T/D+T^(3/2)/C0^2) long-factor estimate pass this adversarial reconstruction. All marked sharp Type I boxes save a fixed power for C0>=T^(7/12+eta), after paid Mellin, moving-cutoff, endpoint, and aggregate losses. J-rem is an exact sharp residual, but its joint saving and the required full neighborhood/all-height transfer remain unproved.
